tasks.title: Enable real provider image Compare through qualified local Admin and canonical Credits
tasks.reason: Billable Comparison admission, virtual wallet and private result transport cross Identity/Generation/Credits/Assets. Five mandatory reviewer roles (Backend, Commercial, Security, QA, UX) are justified by financial, security and UX duties, applied in waves with at most three active agents.
acceptance: Success: Given explicitly qualified local Admin live generation, when quoting/submitting two image slots and funding only its fixture wallet, then canonical Queue/provider/capture and owned results work with clear real API cost disclosure.

Negative: Given unsafe mode, forged request/quote, insufficient funds, grant misuse or foreign output, when invoking the workflow, then it denies before paid dispatch or private delivery and no production financial authority is granted.

Recovery: Given duplicate requests, partial failure or revoked role/mode, when settling/polling/delivering, then charges/refunds occur once, successful results remain and old authority cannot deliver more private data.
